# House of Kalaa

House of Kalaa is a Nashik, Maharashtra based luxury interiors and bespoke furniture studio. The studio creates residential, hospitality, and commercial interiors with 35 years of craft-led execution through its associated workshop and design practice.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://www.houseofkalaa.studio/
- Products: https://www.houseofkalaa.studio/products
- Portfolio: https://www.houseofkalaa.studio/portfolio
- About: https://www.houseofkalaa.studio/about
- Contact: https://www.houseofkalaa.studio/contact
- Sitemap: https://www.houseofkalaa.studio/sitemap.xml

## Services And Topics

- Luxury interior design
- Bespoke furniture
- Turnkey residential interiors
- Hospitality interiors
- Commercial and showroom interiors
- Custom sofas, beds, dining tables, consoles, side tables, coffee tables, and TV units
